purpose: Freeze evaluation cases, cohorts, loss, split, promotion thresholds, and reporting semantics before any tuning or measured promotion claim.
non_claims: This artifact is not an evaluator implementation.
This artifact is not a 300-family relevance cohort, 150-family harm cohort, or 500-invocation operational cohort.
Synthetic cases are representative contract oracles only; they do not establish measured SkillRanker quality.
No live TypeSafe/Jev, harness, network, or provider behavior is claimed by this artifact.

ranking_engine_boundary.provider_output_authority: Provider option IDs are advisory data only; local roster/request maps determine valid skills and publication.

case_model.family_id: Groups near-duplicates and repeated runs; all members of one family stay in one split.
case_model.primary_family_case: At most one primary relevance case per independent family contributes to promotion denominators.
case_model.acceptable_additional_invocations_y: For each case, Y is the independently judged set of acceptable additional invocations under the current user constraints and harness permissions. Already available references can make Y empty; repeatable workflows can remain in Y.
case_model.explicit_separation: Exact explicit skill requests are checked separately from advisory quality metrics so easy exact-name cases do not inflate model ranking quality.
case_model.unjudged_cases: Excluded from relevance denominators with counts visible; operational failures over attempted cohorts remain reported.

train.allowed_use: Fit optional priors or model-independent policy candidates only.
train.forbidden_use: Do not tune on validation/final-test labels; do not include future feedback.

validation.allowed_use: Choose thresholds and candidate policy revisions after training is fixed.
validation.forbidden_use: Do not repeatedly relabel this split as an untouched holdout after selecting policies on it.

final_holdout.allowed_use: Evaluate one frozen selected policy once for promotion evidence.
final_holdout.forbidden_use: Do not tune, redraw, cherry-pick, or backfill missing rerank stages after seeing results.

diagnostic_synthetic.forbidden_use: No promotion, calibration, or statistical quality claim.

loss_policy.normalized_loss: y = loss / 2 for bounded-loss sampling reports.
loss_policy.mutual_exclusion: Each attempted case receives exactly one tuning-loss class; operational status is still reported separately.
loss_policy.rationale: A loss that charges only wrong emitted suggestions is invalid because always abstaining would minimize it without helping positive cases.

missing_replay_response.denominator_effect: Do not impute provider scores, mark as failed, or drop only because inconvenient.

operational_failure_after_case_attempted.denominator_effect: Counts in attempted cohort operational denominator and common loss denominator for attempted-case policy comparisons.

unstarted_due_to_batch_cap_or_deadline.denominator_effect: Does not become an observed failure or success; incomplete cohort cannot promote.

gate_skipped_stage_missing_fit.denominator_effect: Do not fill missing fit/rerank values with zeros.

unjudged_label.denominator_effect: Exclude from relevance denominators with counts; for conservative upper risk bounds assign loss range [0,1] when applicable.

candidate_coverage_at_l.denominator: judged positive advisory primary cases with Y nonempty
candidate_coverage_at_l.notes: Coverage means at least one acceptable skill; optional set recall is reported separately.

end_to_end_top_one_precision.denominator: advisory cases that emit a suggestion

positive_case_suggestion_rate.denominator: all judged positive advisory primary cases
positive_case_suggestion_rate.success: emitted top-one suggestion belongs to Y

needless_suggestion_rate.denominator: all judged no-match advisory primary cases where Y is empty

false_abstention.count: valid relevance abstentions; operational failures reported separately

fit_brier.denominator: judged shortlist pairs in declared sampling frame

relevance_cohort.unit: one preselected primary case per independent task family

uncertainty_and_sampling.confidence_claim_boundary: Prespecify population, sampling design and endpoint model before results. Independent families alone do not justify a binomial model. Wilson intervals are nominal model-based intervals; a quota-selected or diagnostic benchmark cannot claim their coverage without justified assumptions. Otherwise use a prespecified design-valid method or report not established.
uncertainty_and_sampling.weighted_design_reports: Use design-aware bounded-loss methods for stratified probability samples; weighted rows are not binomial pseudo-counts.
uncertainty_and_sampling.diagnostic_fixed_sets: May report descriptive rates only; cannot pass inferential promotion gates.
uncertainty_and_sampling.zero_harm_warning: A degenerate bootstrap over zero observed harms is invalid; zero of 100 has upper bound about 2.95%, zero of 150 about 1.98% under iid binomial assumptions.
uncertainty_and_sampling.seed_policy: A seed proves replayability, not randomness; record randomization provenance and design status before labels are inspected.
